lore.bio:
Alexander Nox used to be one of the brightest scientists in the employ of Humbert Labs, the Frontier’s leading manufacturer of pesticide gases. Nox worked day and night developing new formulas for the glut of pesticides needed to protect the crops that sustained the Outlands. But he soon realized that progress was being hampered by his testing methods. He needed to test on more than just inert tissue: he needed living subjects.
As he toiled in secret, Nox began to see the beauty in his creations and their ability to destroy anything they touched. But the head of Humbert Labs soon discovered his gruesome experiments, and their confrontation ended with the lab in flames. 
Now, competing under the name Caustic, he puts his gaseous creations to work in the Apex Games and observes their effects with great interest. However, as much as he's tried to leave his old self behind, the trappings of his former life are squeezing through the cracks. A cop obsessed with hunting him down; a loving mother who has discovered his death was faked; a bitter enemy revealed to be his half-brother; and an encroaching sickness he may no longer be able to evade. Who knows how long he will be able to avoid such confounding variables.

For more information on Caustic's story, see Caustic (character).

passive.name: Nox Vision
passive.description: Gain extra upgrade points by causing damage with gas, opening deathboxes and scanning ring consoles.

tactical.name: Nox Gas Trap
tactical.description: Place up to 6 canisters that release deadly Nox gas when shot or triggered by enemies. Nox Gas damages and grounds enemies.

ultimate.name: Nox Gas Grenade
ultimate.description: Blankets a large area in Nox Gas. Nox Gas damages and grounds enemies

details: Damage from gas ramps up more slowly, increases every 2 ticks (was every tick).
Removed aim punch when taking damage.

Nox Gas Trap
(Undocumented) Gas traps are now highlighted to enemies within the gas
(Undocumented) Gas traps can no longer be damaged while deploying

Nox Gas Trap
(Undocumented) Gas trap now lasts for 22 seconds (was 11 seconds)
Gas damage and slow now stops immediately after Caustic's squad is eliminated
Gas damage ramps from 4 → 10 max (was 5 → uncapped), damage on knocked players down to flat 4 (was 5)

Gas Damage now increases by 1 each tick (was 5/5/6/6 etc.)
Downed players still only receive 5/tick
Gas Slow effect now only applies on first damage tick for 2s

Upgrades
Particle Diffuser: moved to Level 3
Residual Toxins: moved to Level 2
Fixed gas ramping bug where transitioning from friendly to enemy gas would initially damage for more than intended.

Fortified
No longer reduces headshot damage.

Nox Gas Trap
Nox Gas Traps are now destroyable after detonation:
The Barrels now have 150 hp.
Gas effects will now linger for two seconds after barrel destruction or expiration (gas particles still linger a bit longer as they dissipate).
Detonated traps will now expire at 11 seconds (+2 second gas lingering) instead of 12.5 seconds (no lingering).
Fixed issue where barrels that are still being deployed (mid-throw) were not being deleted after Caustic dies.
Gas damage starts at 5, increases by 1 every other tick indefinitely.
Nox Gas Trap: Reduced cooldown from 25 to 20 seconds.

Nox Gas Grenade:
Reduced cooldown from 3.5 to 3 minutes.
Reduced duration from 20 to 15 seconds.
Nox Gas Grenade: Increased cooldown from 2.5 minutes to 3.5 minutes.
Gas damage is now a flat 5 rather than 6-12.
Fixed a bug that was causing the gas to flicker for some players affected by it.
(Undocumented) Reduced the amount of particles from the gas, effectively providing less cover from the outside.
Nox Gas Grenade: Fixed an edge case where the gas would persist even after his squad was eliminated.
All gas now dissipates as soon as Caustic's team is wiped.
Nox Vision: Sonar abilities no longer stop Caustic's highlight vision.
Nox Gas Trap/ Nox Gas Grenade: Nox Gas no longer causes a blur effect. Damage increased from 4–10 to 6–12.
Fixed Caustic barrels from being placed at an angle on shipping crates.
Removed an inappropriate Caustic voice line.
Fixed an issue where Crypto’s  Surveillance Drone in Caustic gas would play to the whole server.
Fixed an issue with  Nox Gas Traps clipping to  Mobile Respawn Beacons.
Fixed an issue with Pathfinder and Revenant taking less damage from Nox gas.

Nox Gas Trap:
Can now be destroyed by shooting the bottom before it fully inflates.
Teammates can now ping a friendly trap.

Nox Gas Trap:
Friendly gas no longer slows teammates.
Traps no longer triggered from the other side of a door.

Fortified:
Damage reduction increased from 10% to 15%.
Now immune to slow effects from weapon fire.
Nox Gas Grenade: The magnitude of the slow is reduced by 50% when affecting teammates.

Nox Gas Trap:
Caustic barrels can now be triggered or disabled by friendly teammates.
Fixed a rare issue with using consumables while having a Caustic gas canister out.
Fortified: Fixed issue where damage would be taken through shields.
Fortified Passive Perk added which reduces damage taken by 10%.
Gas Damage per tick increased from 1 to 4
Nox Gas Grenade: Throw distance increased from 28 meters to 33 meters.
Adjusted hitbox to better align with shape.

Nox Gas Trap:
Reduced cooldown of Traps from 30 to 25 seconds.
Increased radius and proximity radius by about 10%.
Removed a 1-second delay on the smoke dealing damage to players.
Nox Gas Grenade: Reduced cooldown from 2:30 to 2:00 minutes. (This change was listed in the patch notes but never shipped.)
Fixed ADS view being blocked when using Caustic legendary skins with certain weapon/ optic combos
